name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB Full Armor Knight Gundam (Legendary Titan Edition Ver.)

ja: “　光　の　弓　矢　”　伝　説　の　巨　人　を　射　る　！　！
真 実 の 鏡 に 記 さ れ た 二 つ の 光 が 今 交 わ る -------------------------
「ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ フルアーマー騎士ガンダム」が、 伝説の巨人を倒す“光の弓矢”を携え、装いも豪華な特殊加工を施し、
‘伝説の巨人編Ｖｅｒ．’として登場！　ファン必携の決定版！！
●　メッキ仕上げの“光の弓矢”が 新規で付属！
光の弓矢を新規造形で付属。
表面には、キラキラ輝く オレンジ系の光沢メッキ加工施し、プレミアム感満点！
矢の矢尻・羽根などの細部表現はホイルシールで再現。
※完成品画像は塗装品です。（実際の商品の“光の弓矢”は、両面ツヤありメッキとなります。）
●　メッキ加工＆グロスインジェクション成形で華やか仕上がり！
霞の鎧、力の盾はブルーの光沢メッキ仕上げ。
天空の翼や他外装は、ツヤ感の出るアイスブルーとブルーのグロスインジェクション成形を採用。
●　他仕様
・ 三つの星とブレードアンテナ ・・・ 金メッキ　／　炎の剣 ・・・ クリアレッド成形
・ 軽装タイプ再現可能。
・ ４種類の目を収録した細部再現用ホイルシール付属。
ノンスケール組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：１５才以上

en: Shoot the legendary giant with the “bow and arrow of light”! !
The two lights written in the mirror of truth are now intersecting -------------------------
"LEGENDBB Full Armor Knight Gundam " carries a " bow and arrow of light" that defeats legendary giants, and his outfit has been specially processed to make it luxurious.
‘Legendary Titan Edition Ver. Appeared as '! A must-have edition for fans! !
● A new plated “bow and arrow of light” is included!
A newly shaped bow and arrow of light is included.
The surface is plated with a sparkling orange gloss, giving it a premium feel!
Details such as arrowheads and feathers are reproduced with foil seal.
*The finished product image is a painted product. (The actual product “Yumiya of Light” is plated with gloss on both sides.)
● Gorgeous finish with plating and gloss injection molding!
The haze armor and power shield are finished with blue gloss plating.
The wings of the sky and other exterior parts are made of ice blue and blue gloss injection molding to give it a glossy look.
● Other specifications
・Three stars and blade antenna...Gold plating/Flaming sword...Clear red molding
- Lightly armored type can be reproduced.
- Comes with a foil seal for detail reproduction that includes 4 types of eyes.
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
